---
title: "LIQPLAT analysis-ready data derivation"
date: 2026-08-20
format:
  html:
    toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

This stage joins approved pseudonymized domains and derives analysis-ready
flags. It does not call REDCap, re-extract private fields, or replace missing
source values with zero. Administrative censoring uses the configured lock and
182-day horizon whenever the required event fields are available.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "data_build_analysis_datasets"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
validation_path <- file.path(result_dir, "input-validation.parquet")
cohort_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-cohort.parquet")
recruitment_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-recruitment.parquet")
ctdna_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet")
alterations_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-alterations.parquet")
qol_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-qol.parquet")
taooh_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-taooh.parquet")
imaging_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-imaging.parquet")
progression_bsc_path <- file.path(result_dir, "analysis-progression-bsc.parquet")
status_path <- file.path(result_dir, "build-status.parquet")

manifest_info <- read_private_manifest_if_present(config)
if (is.null(manifest_info)) stop("The input-validation manifest is missing.")
if (!file.exists(validation_path)) {
  stop("Run 00-data/01-validate-inputs.qmd before building analysis datasets.")
}
validation <- read_result_table(validation_path)
if (any(validation$status %in% c("missing_required", "schema_missing",
                                  "manifest_entry_missing", "manifest_marks_unavailable"))) {
  stop("Input validation has required failures; analysis datasets are not built.")
}

private_files <- list.files(
  project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "private_data")),
  pattern = "\\.parquet$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE
)
schema_files <- list.files(project_path(config_get(config, "paths", "schema_dir")),
                           pattern = "\\.yml$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
input_paths <- c(validation_path, manifest_info$path, private_files, schema_files)
output_paths <- c(cohort_path, recruitment_path, status_path)
if (file.exists(private_domain_path(config, "ctdna_samples"))) {
  output_paths <- c(output_paths, ctdna_path)
}
if (file.exists(private_domain_path(config, "alterations"))) {
  output_paths <- c(output_paths, alterations_path)
}
passthrough_output_paths <- c(
  qol = qol_path, taooh = taooh_path, imaging = imaging_path,
  progression_bsc = progression_bsc_path
)
for (domain in names(passthrough_output_paths)) {
  if (file.exists(private_domain_path(config, domain))) {
    output_paths <- c(output_paths, unname(passthrough_output_paths[[domain]]))
  }
}
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "02-build-analysis-datasets.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  build_status <- read_result_table(status_path)
} else {
  cohort_source <- load_private_domain(config, "cohort_follow_up", required = TRUE)
  recruitment_source <- load_private_domain(config, "recruitment", required = TRUE)
  require_public_columns(cohort_source,
                         c("id", "randomization_date", "tx", "diagnosis"),
                         "cohort_follow_up")
  if (anyDuplicated(cohort_source$id)) {
    stop("cohort_follow_up must contain one row per pseudonymized patient.")
  }
  cohort_source$randomization_date <- parse_analysis_date(
    cohort_source$randomization_date, "randomization_date", allow_missing = FALSE
  )
  cohort_source$tx <- validate_binary(cohort_source$tx, "tx", allow_missing = FALSE)
  require_public_columns(recruitment_source,
                         c("id", "screened_date", "eligible"), "recruitment")
  recruitment_source$screened_date <- parse_analysis_date(
    recruitment_source$screened_date, "screened_date", allow_missing = FALSE
  )
  recruitment_source$eligible <- validate_binary(
    recruitment_source$eligible, "eligible", allow_missing = FALSE
  )
  if ("randomization_date" %in% names(recruitment_source)) {
    recruitment_source$randomization_date <- parse_analysis_date(
      recruitment_source$randomization_date, "randomization_date"
    )
  }
  if ("enrolled_date" %in% names(recruitment_source)) {
    recruitment_source$enrolled_date <- parse_analysis_date(
      recruitment_source$enrolled_date, "enrolled_date"
    )
  }
  if ("tx" %in% names(recruitment_source)) {
    recruitment_source$tx <- validate_binary(recruitment_source$tx, "tx")
  }
  write_module_table(recruitment_source, recruitment_path)
  recruitment_groups <- split(seq_len(nrow(recruitment_source)),
                               as.character(recruitment_source$id), drop = TRUE)
  recruitment_rows <- lapply(recruitment_groups, function(index) {
    part <- recruitment_source[index, , drop = FALSE]
    result <- data.frame(
      id = as.character(part$id[[1L]]),
      screened_date = min(part$screened_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      eligible = as.integer(max(part$eligible, na.rm = TRUE)),
      recruitment_records = nrow(part),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    if ("randomization_date" %in% names(part)) {
      values <- part$randomization_date[!is.na(part$randomization_date)]
      result$randomization_date <- if (length(values) == 0L) as.Date(NA) else min(values)
    }
    if ("enrolled_date" %in% names(part)) {
      values <- part$enrolled_date[!is.na(part$enrolled_date)]
      result$enrolled_date <- if (length(values) == 0L) as.Date(NA) else min(values)
    }
    if ("tx" %in% names(part)) {
      values <- unique(part$tx[!is.na(part$tx)])
      if (length(values) > 1L) stop("Conflicting recruitment assignment for patient.")
      result$tx <- if (length(values) == 0L) NA_integer_ else as.integer(values[[1L]])
    }
    result
  })
  recruitment <- do.call(rbind, recruitment_rows)
  rownames(recruitment) <- NULL
  analysis_cohort <- merge(cohort_source, recruitment, by = "id", all = TRUE,
                           suffixes = c("", ".recruitment"))
  for (column_name in intersect(c("randomization_date", "tx"), names(recruitment))) {
    recruitment_name <- paste0(column_name, ".recruitment")
    if (recruitment_name %in% names(analysis_cohort)) {
      analysis_cohort[[column_name]] <- coalesce_checked(
        analysis_cohort[[column_name]], analysis_cohort[[recruitment_name]], column_name
      )
      analysis_cohort[[recruitment_name]] <- NULL
    }
  }
  require_public_columns(analysis_cohort,
                         c("id", "randomization_date", "tx", "diagnosis"),
                         "analysis cohort")
  if (anyNA(analysis_cohort$randomization_date) || anyNA(analysis_cohort$tx)) {
    stop("Analysis cohort has missing randomization assignment after the domain join.")
  }

  death_status_observed <- FALSE
  if ("status_death" %in% names(analysis_cohort)) {
    analysis_cohort$status_death <- validate_binary(analysis_cohort$status_death,
                                                    "status_death")
    if (any(analysis_cohort$status_death == 1 &
            is.na(analysis_cohort$death_date), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      stop("status_death = 1 requires a recorded death_date.")
    }
    death_status_observed <- all(!is.na(analysis_cohort$status_death))
  }
  if ("death_date" %in% names(analysis_cohort) &&
      (any(!is.na(analysis_cohort$death_date)) || death_status_observed)) {
    analysis_cohort$death_date <- parse_analysis_date(analysis_cohort$death_date, "death_date")
    lock_date <- parse_analysis_date(config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                                     "data_lock", allow_missing = FALSE)
    horizon_days <- as.integer(config_get(config, "analysis", "horizon_days"))
    if (is.na(horizon_days) || horizon_days < 1L) {
      stop("analysis.horizon_days must be a positive integer.")
    }
    origin <- parse_analysis_date(analysis_cohort$randomization_date,
                                  "randomization_date", allow_missing = FALSE)
    event_date <- analysis_cohort$death_date
    follow_up_end <- if ("follow_up_end_date" %in% names(analysis_cohort)) {
      parse_analysis_date(analysis_cohort$follow_up_end_date, "follow_up_end_date")
    } else {
      rep(lock_date, nrow(analysis_cohort))
    }
    follow_up_end[is.na(follow_up_end)] <- lock_date
    follow_up_end <- pmin(follow_up_end, lock_date)
    administrative_end <- pmin(origin + horizon_days, follow_up_end)
    if (any(!is.na(event_date) & event_date < origin)) {
      stop("death_date precedes randomization_date.")
    }
    if (any(!is.na(administrative_end) & administrative_end < origin)) {
      stop("Follow-up end precedes randomization_date.")
    }
    event_death <- !is.na(event_date) & event_date <= administrative_end
    event_or_censor_date <- administrative_end
    event_or_censor_date[event_death] <- event_date[event_death]
    analysis_cohort$survival_time_days <- as.numeric(
      event_or_censor_date - origin
    )
    analysis_cohort$event_death <- as.integer(event_death)
    analysis_cohort$censor_date <- administrative_end
    analysis_cohort$event_or_censor_date <- event_or_censor_date
  } else {
    analysis_cohort$survival_derivation_status <- "pending_death_date"
  }
  write_module_table(analysis_cohort, cohort_path)

  ctdna <- load_private_domain(config, "ctdna_samples", required = FALSE)
  status_rows <- list(data.frame(domain = "cohort_follow_up", status = "built",
                                 n_rows = nrow(analysis_cohort),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    domain = "recruitment", status = "joined", n_rows = nrow(recruitment_source),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (!is.null(ctdna)) {
    require_public_columns(ctdna, c("sample_id", "id"), "ctDNA samples")
    if ("sample_date" %in% names(ctdna)) {
      ctdna$sample_date <- parse_analysis_date(ctdna$sample_date, "sample_date")
    }
    if ("analysis_date" %in% names(ctdna)) {
      ctdna$analysis_date <- parse_analysis_date(ctdna$analysis_date, "analysis_date")
    }
    lod_columns <- c("lod_q1", "lod_q3")
    if (all(lod_columns %in% names(ctdna))) {
      sample_dates <- parse_analysis_date(ctdna$sample_date, "sample_date")
      lod_q1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(ctdna$lod_q1)))
      lod_q3 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(ctdna$lod_q3)))
      ctdna$attempted_sample <- !is.na(sample_dates)
      ctdna$ctdna_error_derived <- as.integer(
        ctdna$attempted_sample & is.na(lod_q1) & is.na(lod_q3)
      )
      if ("ctdna_error" %in% names(ctdna)) {
        ctdna$ctdna_error_qc <- validate_binary(ctdna$ctdna_error, "ctdna_error")
      } else {
        ctdna$ctdna_error_qc <- NA_real_
      }
      ctdna$valid_ctdna_result <- ctdna$attempted_sample &
        ctdna$ctdna_error_derived == 0L
    } else {
      ctdna$valid_ctdna_result <- NA
      ctdna$technical_validity_status <- "pending_lod_q1_q3"
    }
    write_module_table(ctdna, ctdna_path)
    status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = "ctdna_samples", status = if (all(lod_columns %in% names(ctdna)))
        "built_with_validity" else "built_validity_pending",
      n_rows = nrow(ctdna), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = "ctdna_samples", status = "optional_missing", n_rows = NA_integer_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  alterations <- load_private_domain(config, "alterations", required = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(alterations)) {
    require_public_columns(alterations, c("alteration_id", "sample_id", "id"),
                           "alterations")
    if (!is.null(ctdna) && "valid_ctdna_result" %in% names(ctdna)) {
      sample_lookup <- ctdna[, intersect(c("sample_id", "valid_ctdna_result",
                                            "ctdna_detected"), names(ctdna)),
                             drop = FALSE]
      if (anyDuplicated(sample_lookup$sample_id)) stop("ctDNA sample IDs are not unique.")
      alterations <- merge(alterations, sample_lookup, by = "sample_id", all.x = TRUE,
                           suffixes = c("", ".sample"))
    } else {
      alterations$valid_ctdna_result <- NA
    }
    write_module_table(alterations, alterations_path)
    status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = "alterations", status = "built", n_rows = nrow(alterations),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = "alterations", status = "optional_missing", n_rows = NA_integer_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  passthrough_domains <- list(
    qol = list(path = qol_path, columns = c("id", "assessment_id", "day", "q30", "baseline_q30")),
    taooh = list(path = taooh_path, columns = c("id", "week", "y_taooh")),
    imaging = list(path = imaging_path, columns = c("imaging_id", "id", "imaging_date")),
    progression_bsc = list(path = progression_bsc_path,
                           columns = c("event_id", "id", "event_date", "event_type"))
  )
  for (domain in names(passthrough_domains)) {
    value <- load_private_domain(config, domain, required = FALSE)
    if (is.null(value)) next
    require_public_columns(value, passthrough_domains[[domain]]$columns, domain)
    write_module_table(value, passthrough_domains[[domain]]$path)
    status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      domain = domain, status = "built", n_rows = nrow(value),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

  pending_rows <- data.frame(
    domain = c("treatment_lines", "weekly_treatment", "solid_msi", "solid_tmb",
               "treatment_details"),
    status = "pending_source_contract",
    n_rows = NA_integer_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  build_status <- rbind(do.call(rbind, status_rows), pending_rows)
  rownames(build_status) <- NULL
  write_module_table(build_status, status_path)
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = c(cohort_path, recruitment_path, status_path,
                     if (file.exists(ctdna_path)) ctdna_path else character(),
                     if (file.exists(alterations_path)) alterations_path else character(),
                     if (file.exists(qol_path)) qol_path else character(),
                     if (file.exists(taooh_path)) taooh_path else character(),
                     if (file.exists(imaging_path)) imaging_path else character(),
                     if (file.exists(progression_bsc_path)) progression_bsc_path else character()),
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "00-data", "02-build-analysis-datasets.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: build-status
#| tbl-cap: "Analysis-dataset build status"

build_status |>
  transform(n_rows = ifelse(is.na(n_rows), "not available", as.character(n_rows))) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
